title: Recipes++
description: A datapack that adds QOL recipes that don't change the core gameplay.
body:
![image_title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6aca022c2386ca7e7ebbc960c3f1aaca4f6bd4f9.png)

This datapack simply aims to add a few nifty recipes that will make the vanilla experience itself better.

### Examples:
- 2 logs ➤ 16 sticks
- 8 logs ➤ 4 chests
- 7 logs ➤ 24 ladders
- 7 planks ➤ 6 ladders
- 3 logs ➤ 16 bowls
- 1.21.6 lead recipe backported

The old recipes still exist, these just add onto them in a nice, simple way
